title: 할 일 목록: 끝내다, 미루다, 바쁘다
objective: By the end, you can use words like 끝내다, 미루다, 바쁘다, 준비하다 and 정리하다 in short sentences about your tasks. You can also say which task you will do first and which one later.
summary: Learn ten everyday words for talking about your to-do list: starting, finishing, putting off, and how busy you are.

task.title: Use the to-do words
task.line: Read each sentence, think about the situation, and choose or write the word that fits.

words.exampleMeaning: I have a lot of work today, so I'm leaving work late.
I have to finish this report by Friday.
Don't put your homework off until tomorrow.

words.example: 요즘 회사 일 때문에 너무 바빠요.
words.exampleMeaning: I'm really busy these days because of work.

words.meaning: to tidy up, to put in order
words.exampleMeaning: I tidied my desk before leaving work.
I'll eat first and then clean.
I'm busy now, so I'll call you later.

words.meaning: to be free, to not be busy
words.exampleMeaning: I'm not very busy on weekends.

exercises: Choose the right word: ① 저는 매일 아침 8시에 일을 (시작해요 / 미뤄요). ② 숙제를 다 (끝내고 / 바쁘고) 게임을 했어요. ③ 피곤해서 청소를 내일로 (미뤘어요 / 정리했어요).
Fill in the blank with 먼저 or 나중에: ① 밥을 먹기 전에 손을 ____ 씻어요. ② 지금은 수업 중이라서 ____ 이야기해요.
Fill in the blank with 바빠요 or 한가해요: ① 오늘은 손님이 없어서 가게가 ____. ② 시험 기간이라서 학생들이 아주 ____.
Fill in the blank with the right form of 준비하다 or 정리하다: ① 친구 생일 파티 음식을 지금 ____ 있어요. ② 옷장이 복잡해서 어제 옷을 ____.
Read Minsu's to-do list and write in Korean the task he put off: 보고서 쓰기 — 끝 / 이메일 보내기 — 지금 하는 중 / 회의 준비 — 내일로 미룸
answers: ① 시작해요 ② 끝내고 ③ 미뤘어요
